concepts.name: rain
concepts.definition: Liquid water falling from clouds.

concepts.name: storm
concepts.definition: A violent atmospheric disturbance with wind and precipitation.

concepts.name: wind
concepts.definition: Air moving across the surface of a world.

concepts.name: cloud
concepts.definition: A visible mass of suspended droplets or ice crystals.

concepts.name: snow
concepts.definition: Ice crystals gathered into flakes and falling from the sky.

concepts.name: lightning
concepts.definition: An electrical discharge through the atmosphere.

concepts.name: scientist
concepts.definition: A person who studies the natural world through evidence.

concepts.name: astronomer
concepts.definition: A scientist who studies objects and events beyond Earth.

concepts.name: midnight
concepts.definition: The quiet boundary between one day and the next.

concepts.name: telescope
concepts.definition: An instrument that gathers distant light for closer study.

concepts.name: Jupiter
concepts.definition: The largest planet in the Solar System, known for its bands and Great Red Spot.

concepts.name: moon
concepts.definition: A natural satellite whose reflected light shapes the night sky.

concepts.name: star
concepts.definition: A luminous sphere of plasma held together by gravity.

concepts.name: Earth
concepts.definition: The home world, a blue planet suspended in space.

concepts.name: gravity
concepts.definition: The attraction between masses that shapes motion and structure.

concepts.name: light
concepts.definition: Electromagnetic radiation visible to the human eye.

concepts.name: shadow
concepts.definition: A region where light is blocked by an object.

concepts.name: clock
concepts.definition: An instrument that measures and displays the passage of time.

concepts.name: silence
concepts.definition: The absence of sound, or a space in which meaning can gather.

concepts.name: question
concepts.definition: An uncertainty that invites inquiry rather than closure.

concepts.name: memory
concepts.definition: The mind's imperfect archive of what has been.

concepts.name: time
concepts.definition: The dimension through which change and experience unfold.

concepts.name: ocean
concepts.definition: A vast body of salt water covering much of a world.

concepts.name: mountain
concepts.definition: A high, enduring rise in the surface of a world.

concepts.name: forest
concepts.definition: A living landscape shaped by trees, shade, and hidden paths.

concepts.name: signal
concepts.definition: A pattern that carries information across distance.

concepts.name: fire
concepts.definition: A rapid chemical reaction that releases heat and light.

concepts.name: door
concepts.definition: A boundary that can open into another space or possibility.
